name: CA-28
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+14 district with long-serving incumbent Judy Chu
Markets price Chu at ~97% to win
No public polling of the general election
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Chu: a D+14 seat, incumbency, and a dominant fundraising edge over April Verlato, with prediction markets pricing her near certain. With no polls to refine the estimate, the forecast stays at the fundamentals-implied margin with wide uncertainty.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a much tighter race, or a major shift in the national environment, would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Judy Chu seeks another term in a Los Angeles-area district that leans Democratic by about fourteen points. She advanced to the general election and holds a large financial advantage, with roughly $3.7 million on hand compared with about $205,000 for Republican April Verlato, who has raised only a quarter million dollars. Outside spending in the race is minimal.

No public polls cover the contest, and no expert raters have weighed in, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and money. Prediction markets price Chu's chances at about 97 percent. The expected margin is roughly 22 points for Chu, with meaningful uncertainty given the absence of polling.
